Chapter 682: Chapter 15: Breakthrough Preparation (Subscribe Request)

Chapter 682: Chapter 15: Breakthrough Preparation (Subscribe Request)

“Yes, yes, yes!” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, his tone invigorated, growing increasingly satisfied as he observed Lin Yuan.

Over the long years, he had nurtured several descendants, pouring his heart and soul into them.

These descendants possessed the blood essence of a Twelfth-Rank Life, further enhanced by the cultivation from a Supreme Being himself.

Indeed, they achieved significant accomplishments.

But compared to Lin Yuan?

Xia Qin Supreme Being even blushed a little.

...

So far, the only nurturing that Xia Qin Supreme Being had done for the Galaxy Master was to take him on a trip to the Banks of the River of Time.

As for more?

There was none.

The Soul-Settling Pearl that could resist attacks of the same ultimate level… in fact, any peerless genius of human civilization summoned by a Supreme Being usually received one.

The only difference Xia Qin Supreme Being made for Lin Yuan compared to other human peerless geniuses was to let the Galaxy Master view the entirety of the River of Time during his Ninth Rank.

Such an opportunity could be considered big, but also not so big.

For mediocre talents, seeing or not seeing made no difference.

Even for the peerless evolutionary geniuses, it would only slightly facilitate their understanding of the Rule of Time.

But Lin Yuan?

Having only observed for a while, he understood the Rule of Time in less than thirty years?

Such an achievement left even Xia Qin Supreme Being somewhat dumbfounded.

He indeed had the expectation that Lin Yuan would understand the Rule of Time when reaching the Ninth Rank.

But he had not expected it to happen so quickly.

“Yes, yes, yes?” Lin Yuan looked toward Xia Qin Supreme Being seated on the throne.

During the first summons by Xia Qin Supreme Being, even when he learned that Lin Yuan was the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

Xia Qin Supreme Being showed only a hint of appreciation in his eyes, but to be this excited now? To say ‘yes’ three times?

Before today, Lin Yuan had not expected the Supreme Being to show such emotional fluctuation.

“It seems that understanding the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank and breaking through to the Tenth Rank brings more rewards than I imagined,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“When will the transformation be complete?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being observed Lin Yuan for a while and then asked.

Being a Supreme Being, he naturally knew all the details of breaking through from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank.

The physical soul, spirit will, and even the Inner World were all undergoing a slow transformation.

Once the transformation reached a critical point, the final breakthrough could occur, completely entering the Tenth Rank.

During this period, it was best for an Evolver not to exert full effort, as it could impact the progress of their transformation.

After completely traversing the Ninth Layer, Lin Yuan had waited until the end of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm before attempting the breakthrough, fearing that something unexpected might happen during the transformation period.

Breaking from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank, once it began, not only Lin Yuan’s main body would transform, but his two Primordial Spirits would as well.

“It originally required sixty years.”

“Now, at most twenty years, I can reach the peak of transformation and then break through,” Lin Yuan said immediately.

Why must a Ninth Rank Evolver at least open up tens of millions of Spatial Layers to meet the threshold for breaking through to the Tenth Rank?

Because only with that number of layers could they barely continue transforming and ultimately step into the Tenth Rank.

But here ‘barely’ means just that; the more Spatial Layers opened, the easier the transformation process becomes.

“You grasped the Rule of Time, now holding command over time and space, your Inner World complete and independent, naturally, your transformation speed would skyrocket,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, nodding.

Just like the speed of two wheels certainly cannot compare to four wheels or eight wheels.

And with the Rule of Time merged into the Inner World compared to one merely supported by Space Rules, is it just about adding a few more wheels?

It’s a major qualitative change, a vast leap.

“Breaking from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank, even ordinary Evolvers need to endure the infusion of Cosmic Origin, and must not be disturbed during this period,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, looking at Lin Yuan.

Ordinary Evolvers need to endure the infusion of Cosmic Origin.

And Lin Yuan would need to endure the infusion from the Chaos Void Origin.

And must be even more undisturbed.

“Where does the Supreme Being plan for me to break through?” Lin Yuan proactively inquired.

A Supreme Being definitely knew these matters best.

“Like this, you should break through within the Milky Way Star Region,” said Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Additionally, try to recall your avatars from outside during the breakthrough,” he continued after thinking for a while.

Breaking from the Ninth Rank to the Tenth Rank definitely required doing so in the safest place possible.

There are a few safest areas in human civilization,

one is the Central Star Domain, the old nest of human civilization, presided over by numerous Clan Suppression Weapons.

Even a Supreme Being from a different species arriving there wouldn’t gain any advantage.

The second is the various Evolution Towers.

The Evolution Towers are places where Supreme Beings have their bases.

Being inside a tower is akin to having the protection of a Supreme Being.

Equally safe.

But,

the speed of transformation within Lin Yuan’s Inner World was simply too fast.

Less than twenty years from reaching the pinnacle of transformation.

Whether it was the nearest Evolution Tower or the Central Star Domain,

both were countless tens of thousands of light-years away from the Milky Way Star Region.

If Lin Yuan wanted to go there, he would inevitably need to spend a lot of time on the road.

And that, Xia Qin Supreme Being felt, was inappropriate.

After all, Lin Yuan was the only existence in human civilization, up until now, who had understood the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank.

He might also be the only one within this entire Cosmic Epoch, from the birth to the destruction of this universe.

It was natural not to waste the precious time before his breakthrough traveling.

“I will dispatch an incarnation to the Milky Way Star Region, you just concentrate on your breakthrough,” said Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Although the Milky Way Star Region is covered by the Virtual World network, allowing the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being to descend an incarnation anytime, anywhere,

But Lin Yuan is, after all, the person Xia Qin has taken an interest in.
